tools.description: Find startups and other venture-backed private companies by sector, stage, location (headquarters city or country), what the company does, or when they last raised, one row per company: which fintech startups in London raised this month, the most-funded AI infrastructure companies, seed-stage climate companies in Germany. Each carries its headquarters, sector, what it does, total raised, round count and newest round; use companies/profile for one company's valuation and full funding.

Browse or search the public YC company directory. Query is optional: omit it to list every company matching the exact source labels for batch (e.g. Summer 2025), industry, region, status and tag, or the hiring, top company and nonprofit flags. Twenty entries per zero-based page, at most fifty pages.
Find code examples, official documentation, repository discussions or agent skills for a development task.

To find Anthropic engineering posts (agent evals, tool search and deferred tool loading, building effective agents, postmortems), recent announcements to monitor, or research posts, before reading one with get_post.

List public jobs advertised on a YC company profile, including source salary text, location, role and requirements. Each record adds best-effort structured locations, a remote/hybrid/onsite flag and ISO country codes parsed from the location text, plus the source role slug, skills, posting age, apply link and batch. No application or contact actions.
You need the contact details of a Delaware registered agent named on an entity record, or the full list of agents the Division publishes.
To see past and current registered agents of an entity.
You have a reg_agent_id from search_entities or get_entity and need the agent's address or the list of entities it represents.

Call to discover what is covered, or to resolve names to identifiers when you do not already have a ticker. Check the per-company dataset list before assuming a costlier capability will answer for it.

Call first when starting from a company name or ticker: it returns every other identifier, so one call here makes the rest of this provider addressable. Also the only place peers and secondary listings are published.
List every batch label published in the public YC directory with its company count, newest first. Use a returned batch label as the search batch filter.
Read a public YC company profile: description, batch, location, team size, source-reported status and the founders listed on the profile (name, title, bio, LinkedIn and X/Twitter links).
List a channel's live streams, upcoming streams/premieres and stream replays, paged by continuation.
List the public playlists a channel shows, paged by continuation.
List a channel's Shorts, newest first, paged by continuation.
List a channel's uploads, newest first, paged by continuation.
Read a comment thread after video_comments.
List the videos in a public playlist, paged by continuation.
